tasks.label: Open Web Dashboard
tasks.command:
python3 -c 'import urllib.request, webbrowser, subprocess, time; exec("try:
  urllib.request.urlopen("http://localhost:8000")
except:
  subprocess.Popen(["python3", "-m", "http.server", "8000", "--directory", "dashboard"])
  time.sleep(0.5)
webbrowser.open("http://localhost:8000")")'
